data.narrative:
Tenna Systems is a Seed-stage Defense & Security company that has raised $13.5M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comparable universe of ten firms: two public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and eight private peers including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic. The five most directly comparable firms span Seed and Series A stages, with valuations ranging from $125M to $4.0B.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $13.5M raised as a proxy base value and applies a 2.5x multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage step-ups, yielding $34M. Peer-median analysis across five same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables produces a median valuation of $1.0B, with a distribution spanning $125M to $4.0B. The wide peer range reflects heterogeneity within Defense & Security funding environments and stage advancement.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $29M to $1.1B, with a median of $517M. The stage-progression method anchors the low end; peer-median data dominates the upper bound. Key uncertainties include the timing and terms of the next financing round, product maturity relative to the peer set, and customer traction in a government-constrained end-market. The wide range reflects genuine ambiguity around whether Tenna will track toward the sub-$200M or multi-billion-dollar outcome represented in the peer cohort.
